name: AMBANK
recent: AMMB 近期完成以 RM331 million 向 AMFIRST REIT 收购 Menara AmBank 的交易，并于 2026 年 10 月 23 日结清余款。EPF 持续减持，持股降至 17.2%。最新季度营收环比增长 3.5%，净利环比基本持平。
notable: AMMB 旗下 AmBank 以 RM331 million 向 AMFIRST REIT 收购 Menara AmBank，交易已于 2026 年 10 月 23 日完成。
EPF 于 10 月底进一步减持 780 万股后，持股比例降至 17.2%。
CG (L) Foundation 于 10 月 29 日披露成为大股东（持股超过 5%）。
risks: EPF 在 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报减持 AMMB 股份。
公司于 11 月 4 日公告一项清盘 / 接管 / 限制令 / 特别管理人事项（公告编号 9）。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 MYR 1,312.96 million，环比增长 3.5%，同比增长 3.3%；净利为 MYR 520.23 million，环比微降 0.1%，同比增长 0.8%；净利率为 39.6%，低于上一季度的 41.0%。

recent_en: AMMB recently completed the RM331 million acquisition of Menara AmBank from AMFIRST REIT, settling the balance on 23 October 2026. EPF continued to reduce its stake to 17.2%. Latest quarter revenue rose 3.5% QoQ while net profit was flat QoQ.
notable_en: AmBank, a wholly-owned subsidiary of AMMB, acquired Menara AmBank from AMFIRST REIT for RM331 million, completed on 23 October 2026.
EPF further disposed 7.8 million shares in late October, reducing its stake to 17.2%.
CG (L) Foundation disclosed on 29 October that it became a substantial shareholder (stake above 5%).
risks_en: EPF filed multiple notices of reduction in AMMB shares during October and November.
The company announced a winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator matter on 4 November (announcement no. 9).
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 1,312.96 million, up 3.5% QoQ and 3.3% YoY; net profit was MYR 520.23 million, down 0.1% QoQ and up 0.8% YoY; net margin was 39.6%, lower than 41.0% in the previous quarter.
